target_customer: Developers building LLM applications that call tools (original product); ecommerce store operators scoring readiness for AI shopping agents (current site)
problem: LLM developers had to integrate each model's tool calling separately; the current site addresses whether online stores work for AI shopping agents.
business_model: Usage-based API originally; current site offers a free scan and a Pro plan at 99 USD per store per month
product_category: Developer tools, LLM tool use API, later agent readiness scoring for ecommerce

founders.name: Andy Qin
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: 7th employee at Modern Treasury (YC S18) building Ledgers, earlier a Stripe engineer on API developer experience and Stripe Atlas. Education not listed.

competitors.name: OpenAI function calling
competitors.what: Native tool calling in the OpenAI API, released with gpt-4-0613 and gpt-3.5-turbo-0613
competitors.traction_then: available to all OpenAI API developers from launch

technical_complexity.rationale: Normalizing tool schemas across model providers and hosting tool execution is routine API engineering for a one person team.

defensibility.rationale: Model vendors added native tool calling in June 2023, and wrappers and routers are easy to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: OpenAI shipped function calling on 2023-06-13, the same quarter as the batch, absorbing the wedge.

market_need_then: Developers were starting to build agents on LLM tool use in mid 2023, and OpenAI's function calling announcement shows demand, but per model tooling was fragmented.

branding.domain_note: Current site is opentools.com. A separate AI tools directory uses opentools.ai and other products share the name; how the .com was obtained was not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Positions its Agent Usability Rating as an industry standard

branding.brand_signature: Agent Usability Rating score levels from Blocked to Agent-Native

brand_strength.rationale: Search results mix this company with several unrelated OpenTools products, showing the name is not distinctive.

pivots.to: Agent Usability Rating for ecommerce stores
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred from YC description versus the current opentools.com site, exact date unknown

outcome_analysis: OpenTools is listed as active with a team of three, but no funding was found. Its original wedge, an API for LLM tool use, was covered by native function calling from OpenAI in June 2023, and the current site now sells agent readiness scores for online stores, which suggests a repositioning whose date is not public. Treat the failure factors as a tentative reading of this timeline.
notes: No funding information found in two searches; investor tracker Altss is gated. Cannot confirm whether the arXiv OpenTools paper or opentools.ai directory relate to this company; they do not. The pivot is inferred from comparing the YC tagline with the current site, not from a company statement. Education not found.
